cases.name: Isabel Hernandez-Hernandez
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She loved bowling, watching her children play sports, the beach, cooking, playing board games, Starbucks, hey dudes and then most importantly spending time with her family." On Facebook, her son Angel Rascon paid loving tribute to her: "Isabel was a bright, strong, independent, great mother, daughter, sister, who worked hard to provide for her family.. I know many of you got the opportunity to be touched by her love and kindness and got to witness how great of a person she truly was. I have no words to explain the pain and suffering our family is going through right now but only god knows why it was time for her to go with him and be with us from above. She might be gone here, but we will always carry her name and soul with us as we fight to make her proud and make sure her little ones have the opportunity to Strive for a happy, peaceful life. "
